description: Put your photos back in the correct order! MediaDateFix is a free, open-source Android app for repairing photo and video dates. Whether you are migrating to a new phone, uploading photos from a camera, or reorganizing your collection, this app will allow you to put your photos back in the correct order on your Android device. DISCLAIMER: This app is not vibe-coded. All code and documentation written for this project was done by hand, by humans. Please consult the README in our source code for more information. Features: - Match modification dates to image metadata: With this app, your photos will be back in the correct order. - Repair missing metadata using the image file name: No metadata? No problem. This app can infer the correct date taken from the image file name. - Keep your photo dates safe: For images on your phone with no metadata and no date in the file name, you can add the current modification date to the file name so that your dates will stay safe.
